fields.taxable_income: The money output of Section63.TaxableIncome for the taxpayer and period.
fields.filing_status: The FilingStatus output of Section2.FilingStatusFor, converted constructor-for-constructor to Section1.FilingStatus.
fields.unemployment_tax: The tax output of Section3301.UnemploymentTax for the taxpayer as employer and the same period.

composition.factual_input: The deterministic converter emits Definitions.World, Entity, and TaxPeriod inputs for Sections 2, 63, and 3301.
composition.world_shape: Five lists: dependency_candidates (Entity), financial_facts (FinancialFact), relationship_facts (RelationshipFact), employment_facts (EmploymentFact), status_facts (StatusFact). Empty lists mean no facts; no fixed capacities or padding.
composition.legal_evaluation: Generated Catala evaluates Section2.FilingStatusFor, Section63.TaxableIncome, and Section3301.UnemploymentTax. The evaluator converts those typed outputs into Api.TotalTax inputs; Api delegates the statutory schedule and summation to Section1.TotalTax.
composition.converter: prolog_to_catala.sara_fresh.adapter.catala_inputs accepts native lists or legacy numbered-slot JSON; versioned legacy_inputs.json fixtures are migrated for the 97 original tax cases.
composition.composer: Api.TotalTaxFromWorld validates the list-based factual World and composes the gold scopes natively; existing scalar Api.TotalTax remains available.
composition.attribute_value_type: Definitions.FactValue: Known classification or Named Entity reference. Renamed from Value to avoid the OCaml runtime module name.

normalization.birth_dates: Explicit DOBs are distinct from relationship effective dates; reject conflicting explicit DOBs. Relationship-date age fallback is requested per provision.
normalization.family_edges: Normalize child-parent orientation and symmetric sibling edges per effective interval; retain source kinds.
normalization.transactions: Deduplicate the same transaction identity, never equal amounts across distinct identities; reject inconsistent aliases.
normalization.classifications: Merge purpose/location classification labels in a derived set without replacing physical locations.
normalization.itemization: Year-aware evidence helper merges explicit election subjects and dated deduction facts.
normalization.provenance: Historical numbered rows remain only in legacy_inputs.json; native inputs and generated Catala tests use lists. Derived canonical JSON is not an independently editable source.
